verdicts.reason: Both break the product duo: the serum bottle shrinks to a tiny stray icon in the bottom-left while the cream jar is blown up to dominate the canvas, and the peach circle sits on its own in the bottom-right corner as an empty blob. A is a little better because its headline, subcopy and CTA share one left edge and stay grouped, though its centred logo clashes with the left-aligned text and the serum is jammed under the CTA. B scatters everything: the logo is pushed oddly to the top-right, there is a large dead gap between the headline and subcopy, the centred CTA sits squeezed against the circle, and the serum is pressed against the bottom edge.
